0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Utah Jazz visit the Memphis Grizzlies. Utah is without Blake Hinson (hamstring), Jusuf Nurkic (foot), Tony Bradley (quadriceps), and Trey Alexander (knee), while Memphis has Isaiah Stewart (ankle) listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and their most recent meeting, on April 10, 2026 in Salt Lake City, ended with the Jazz winning 147-101.
